entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Oh? Good, you're here...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It seems you have obtained a[n]Neko Shogun with Dekaja.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph, you're really getting the hang of[n]this whole growth thing.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What's wrong, Justine?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: It is nothing vital...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: However... presiding over the growth of[n]another feels almost... nostalgic, in a way...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Do you feel the same, Caroline?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We've never taken care of someone[n]like this before.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You are not wrong about that...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: And yet, our duty to aid his rehabilitation[n]aside, observing his growth feels oddly[n]familiar...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That can't be right! The inmate's growth[n]and this rehabilitation are the exact same[n]thing!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hey, Inmate. The growth you're getting[n]from these tasks is helping with your[n]rehabilitation, right?
I don't know.
Probably.
Don't ask me.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: See, Justine? They're the same.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Is that not something we should judge[n]for ourselves, though?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Eh, you prolly just don't realize yet.[n]You have a totally different air about[n]you now.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Anyway, Justine, don't forget about our[n]job. The duty we've been handed is all[n]that matters.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Don't think about anything else.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I suppose... you are correct...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I guess you're gonna keep worrying[n]about this till the inmate finishes his[n]rehabilitation, huh, Justine?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Look what you've done, Inmate! Getting[n]us all wrapped up in your fate... Ugh.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Could it be...?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: What's wrong?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...Nothing.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: But... I believe I am beginning to look[n]forward to seeing whether the inmate[n]can complete his tasks.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You heard her. DON'T disappoint us,[n]Inmate!
I feel like my bond with Caroline[n]and Justine is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Okay! On to the next task!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: ...Justine?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...Yes. Here is the second task for gaining[n]the next privilege that we will grant you.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Try to obtain a Lachesis with Tetraja.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: All you need to do is talk to us with it[n]in your possession. We will know.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: That's a Lachesis—one with Tetraja!
